name: Fair Human-Centric Image Dataset
description: A human-centric image dataset designed to benchmark fairness and ethical behavior of vision models across demographic and contextual factors.
evaluation_method: accuracy combined with group/fairness metrics (demographic parity difference, equalized odds gap, subgroup accuracy/F1)
general_score_metric: accuracy plus fairness gap (e.g., demographic parity difference)
reputation: An emerging dataset in fairness and ethical vision research; used by groups evaluating demographic and contextual model biases but not as universally adopted as mainstream vision benchmarks.
notes: Contains sensitive demographic attributes — risk of privacy concerns and labeling bias; performance should be reported per subgroup as well as overall; dataset imbalances and annotation biases can confound fairness metrics; not an LLM benchmark.
